train_one_epoch: train a PyTorch model for one epoch using a data loader, optimizer, and loss scaler with mixed precision
evaluate: evaluate a PyTorch model on a test data loader and return accuracy and loss metrics
run_train_one_epoch_with_mixup: run train_one_epoch with a mixup function to augment samples and targets during training
run_train_one_epoch_with_cosub: run train_one_epoch with CoSub consistency loss that splits outputs and applies mutual distillation
run_evaluate_with_amp: run evaluate with automatic mixed precision to compute Acc@1, Acc@5, and loss on a data loader
